welcome.tagline:
One selfie. One stranger.
Every day.
welcome.subtitle: Send a selfie, get one back from someone, somewhere in the world. Both are revealed at the same time.
welcome.adultsOnly: For people aged 18 and over only

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.subtitle: Get a sign-in code by email. No password.

birthdate.title: Your date of birth
birthdate.subtitle: BPS is for adults only. It will never be shown on your profile and cannot be changed later.
birthdate.confirmBody: You were born on {{date}}. This date cannot be changed later.

underage.title: Sorry
underage.body: BPS is only for people aged 18 and over. Your account cannot be created.

suspended.title: Account suspended
suspended.body: Your account has been suspended following a moderation decision. Contact support if you think this is a mistake.

terms.title: Before you start
terms.subtitle: BPS is built on respect. No nudity, no harassment, no illegal content: every photo is checked and you can report at any time.
terms.acceptTerms: I accept the Terms of Service
terms.acceptPrivacy: I have read the Privacy Policy and agree to the processing of my data to run the service
terms.acceptRules: I agree to follow the community guidelines

profileSetup.title: Your profile
profileSetup.subtitle: This is what people you swap selfies with will see.
profileSetup.usernameHint: 3 to 30 characters: lowercase letters, digits, "_" and "."

home.title: BPS
home.empty: Your feed is empty for now. Posts from people you follow will show up here. To meet people: the daily selfie (soon) or the QR code (soon).

selfie.title: Daily selfie
selfie.body: Take a selfie: it'll be swapped with a stranger's, somewhere in the world. Both are revealed at the same time.
selfie.reminderBody: A stranger is waiting for you somewhere in the world.
selfie.frontOnly: Front camera only, no filters: that's the game.
selfie.cameraPermissionBody: BPS needs your front camera to take your selfie.
selfie.waitingBody: Somewhere in the world, someone is sending their selfie. Both photos will be revealed at the same time.
selfie.waitingLeave: You can leave this screen: your selfie stays in the queue.
selfie.cancelConfirm: Remove your selfie from the queue?
selfie.expiredBody: No selfie arrived within 30 minutes. Try again, especially during the daily wave!
selfie.rate_limited: Easy! Too many selfies in one hour, try again a bit later.
selfie.selfie_already_pending: You already have a selfie waiting.
selfie.dailyReminderHint: One notification a day, at the same time for your whole part of the world.
selfie.notificationsBlocked: Notifications are turned off for BPS in your phone settings.

messages.title: Messages
messages.emptyPrimary: No conversations yet. To message someone, follow them and tap "Message" on their profile.
messages.emptyRequests: No requests. Messages from people you don't follow land here, without notifications.
messages.requestBanner: @{{username}} wants to message you. You don't follow them: they won't see whether you've read their message.
messages.deleteConfirm: Delete this conversation? It will only disappear on your side.
messages.blockConfirm: Block @{{username}}? You won't be able to see, follow or message each other, or be matched in the daily selfie. They won't be notified.
messages.requestPending: Message sent. @{{username}} needs to accept your request (or follow you) before you can write again.
messages.noPhotoYet: Photos will be possible once @{{username}} accepts your request.
messages.longPressHint: Long-press a conversation to delete it.

qr.title: QR code
qr.myCodeHint: Let someone in front of you scan this code: they'll be able to follow you.
qr.regenerateConfirm: Your current code will stop working (including screenshots already shared). Continue?
qr.scanHint: Point at a friend's BPS QR code.
qr.notBps: This is not a BPS QR code.
qr.cameraPermissionBody: BPS needs the camera to scan QR codes.
qr.invalid: This QR code is no longer valid. Ask your friend to show their current code.
qr.privateHint: Private account: your request will need to be approved.

profile.privateHint: Follow this account to see their photos and stories.
profile.notFound: This profile doesn't exist or is no longer available.
profile.removeFollowerConfirm: Remove @{{username}} from your followers? They won't be notified.
profile.muted: @{{username}} is muted: their posts and stories no longer appear in your feed.

settings.title: Settings
settings.languageNotTranslated: Translation in progress — English is used in the meantime
settings.privateAccountHint: Only people you approve can see your posts, stories and follower lists.

setup.title: Missing configuration
setup.body: Create apps/mobile/.env from .env.example with your Supabase project URL and key, then restart the app.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.birth_date_already_set: Your date of birth is already saved
errors.underage_locked: BPS is for people aged 18 and over
errors.onboarding_not_allowed: This action is not available at this step
errors.not_authenticated: Session expired, please sign in again
errors.photoPermission: Allow photo access in your phone settings
errors.upload: Upload failed. Check your connection and try again.
errors.qr_invalid: This QR code is no longer valid.
errors.tooManyAttempts: Too many attempts. Try again in a while.
errors.must_follow: You need to follow this person to message them.
errors.request_pending: Wait until your request is accepted.
errors.no_media_in_requests: No photos until your request is accepted.
errors.content_rejected: This photo breaks the community guidelines (nudity, violence…). It wasn't published.
errors.moderation_required: The photo couldn't be checked. Try again in a moment.
errors.no_face: We can't see a face in this selfie. Retake it facing the camera!

create.title: Create
create.storyHint: A photo your followers can see for 24h
create.caption: Write a caption…
create.cameraPermission: Allow camera access in your phone settings

post.notFound: This post no longer exists or isn't visible.
post.pending: ⏳ Under review: only you can see it for now.

story.noViewers: Nobody has seen your story yet.

match.expired: This swap is over 24h old: the photos have been deleted.

report.title: Report @{{username}}
report.subtitle: Why? Your report is anonymous.
report.thanks: Thanks. Our team will review this report.

account.contact: To appeal this decision, write to: [CONTACT EMAIL TO BE COMPLETED]
account.deletionBody: Your account will be permanently deleted on {{date}}. Until then, it's invisible to everyone.
account.cancelDeletion: Cancel deletion and keep my account
account.deleteIntro: Your account will be deactivated immediately (invisible to everyone), then permanently deleted after 30 days: profile, photos, selfies, messages, follows.
account.deleteUndo: Changed your mind? Sign in again within 30 days to cancel.
account.deleteExportHint: Export your data first if you want to keep it.
account.deleted: Your account will be deleted on {{date}}.
account.exportBody: You'll get a file with your info, follows, posts, selfies and messages, with download links to your photos valid for 7 days.

admin.title: Moderation
admin.note: Reason (sent to the user if suspended or banned)
